claims.claim: A top is shown worn on a person
claims.label: NOVEL
claims.reason: The DOM identifies the product as a top but does not state that it is being worn by a person; the claim adds the visual presentation context.

claims.label: AVOIDABLE_REDUNDANCY
claims.reason: The DOM explicitly describes the garment as having a round neck, round collar, and crew neck. Repeating the neckline type adds no new visual grounding or disambiguation.

claims.label: NOVEL
claims.reason: Although the DOM states that the garment has short sleeves, it does not specify their broad width; the claim adds a visual sleeve-shape attribute.

claims.label: NOVEL
claims.reason: The DOM describes the fit as loose or oversized but does not fully represent the straight body silhouette; the claim adds visual information about the garment's overall shape.

claims.claim: Visible side slit at the lower left hem
claims.label: UNAVOIDABLE_REPETITION
claims.reason: The DOM already states that the top has a side slit, but repeating the slit is necessary to anchor the new spatial detail that it is visible at the lower-left hem.
